honesty_note: P0 PASS at 717ba69. The founder's original complaint is off the screen: campaign 22 «حملة الإجازات المرضية — ١٣/٨/٢٠٢٦» now reports أُرسلت ٢ · وصلت ٠ · شوهدت ٠ · ردّوا ٠ · جهات مهتمة ٠ · فشل الإرسال ٢, which is the ground truth (both contacts' delivered/read/reply timestamps are 2026-08-12, ~35h BEFORE the 2026-08-13T18:10:40.706Z launch; both carry a failed timestamp seconds after it). campWin() sliced verbatim out of the SERVED /dashboard returns a finite epoch equal to created_at for 22 of 22 live campaigns (0 return 0, 0 return Infinity) — the int8-as-digit-string no-op of f26a2c1 is gone. The windowed result differs from the pre-fix lifetime result for 5 of 22 campaigns and is legitimately identical for the other 17, whose events all post-date their launch. TWO NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS ARE REPORTED, NOT HIDDEN. (1) P2, latent: the ISO fallback regex reaches the browser as /^d{4}-d{2}/ — the \d escapes are consumed by the TS template literal at src/dashboard.ts:388 — so it matches nothing and every ISO string returns Infinity. The direction is FAIL-CLOSED (shows nothing, never everything) and no live campaign reaches that branch because created_at is always a positive epoch-millis digit-string, so no delivered number is wrong; the branch is nonetheless dead code that does not do what its comment claims. (2) P2, cosmetic: on #kmon/22 the counters correctly read ردّوا ٠ while the target row's الحالة chip still reads «ردّ» (a lifetime contact fact, not a campaign number). The commit's contract covers campaign NUMBERS and holds; the row chip is a separate surface and is filed for the next cycle. PROVENANCE: local git HEAD advanced to the later, UNDEPLOYED commit f023acd mid-run; the served bundle contains none of f023acd's dashboard change, and both gate logs pre-date it, so every artifact here binds 717ba69.
no_send_enforcement: Read-only admin GETs only (/health, /admin/state, /admin/campaigns, /admin/customer/:phone) plus browser GETs of /dashboard. Zero POST/PUT/PATCH to any route. src/gupshup.ts was never imported or invoked. campStats was executed inside an isolated node:vm context that was asserted at runtime to expose no fetch, no XMLHttpRequest and no require before any campaign code ran.

cases.title: campaign 22's numbers are windowed to that campaign's launch
cases.persona: the founder opening the campaign he launched minutes ago
cases.preconditions: Given campaign id=22 «حملة الإجازات المرضية — ١٣/٨/٢٠٢٦», created_at "1786644640706" = 2026-08-13T18:10:40.706Z, 2 targets (966535106365, 966543464327). Both contacts' sent/delivered/read timestamps are 2026-08-12 (06:54:3x and 08:52:1x) and both last spoke on 2026-08-12 — roughly 35h BEFORE the launch. Both carry a failed timestamp on 2026-08-13 (18:10:47.584Z and 18:10:44.633Z) and no delivered timestamp after launch.
cases.steps: When campWin/atOrAfter/repliedIn/seenOf/interestedOf/campStats/contactByPhone are sliced VERBATIM (3090 bytes, sha256 prefix 702a50137e55b6ec) out of the LIVE deployed /dashboard HTML and executed in a node:vm against the live /admin/state + /admin/campaigns payloads, and the same input is scored by a re-implementation of the pre-fix lifetime logic.
cases.expected: Then campStats(22) reports targeted 2 · sent 2 · delivered 0 · seen 0 · replied 0 · interested 0 · failed 2, and that result is NOT byte-identical to the lifetime result.
cases.actual: campWin(camp22) returned 1786644640706, exactly created_at. campStats returned {targeted:2,sent:2,delivered:0,seen:0,replied:0,interested:0,failed:2} — the expected windowed truth. The lifetime re-implementation returned {targeted:2,sent:2,delivered:2,seen:2,replied:2,interested:1,failed:0}. DEPLOYED === LIFETIME evaluated to false, so the window is genuinely applied rather than a no-op.
cases.measured: DEPLOYED 717ba69: {targeted:2,sent:2,delivered:0,seen:0,replied:0,interested:0,failed:2} | LIFETIME pre-fix: {targeted:2,sent:2,delivered:2,seen:2,replied:2,interested:1,failed:0} | DEPLOYED===LIFETIME: false | campWin(22)=1786644640706 === created_at.

cases.title: the fix holds across the whole campaign population, not just campaign 22
cases.persona: an operator scrolling the campaign list after months of sends
cases.preconditions: Given all 22 campaigns returned by the live /admin/campaigns, whose created_at values arrive from node-pg as int8 digit-strings, and the live contact ledger from /admin/state.
cases.steps: When the deployed campWin is applied to every campaign, and campStats is compared to the lifetime re-implementation campaign by campaign.
cases.expected: Then every campaign resolves to a finite positive window equal to its own created_at (none falls through to 0 or Infinity), and campaigns whose history predates their launch must diverge from the lifetime numbers.
cases.actual: 22 of 22 campaigns resolved to a finite epoch window, and campWin equalled created_at exactly for 22 of 22. Zero campaigns returned window 0 (the f26a2c1 no-op signature) and zero fell through to Infinity. The windowed result differs from lifetime for 5 campaigns and is identical for 17 — legitimate, since those 17 have no event predating their own launch.
cases.measured: campWin finite-and-correct: 22/22 · win===0: 0/22 · win===Infinity: 0/22 · windowed differs from lifetime: 5/22 · legitimately identical: 17/22.

cases.title: a stale reply, tag or read receipt can no longer be credited to a newer campaign
cases.persona: a sales lead judging whether a fresh blast actually landed
cases.preconditions: Given contact 966535106365, who replied and was read on 2026-08-12T06:54Z and carries lifetime interest tags, and campaign 22, launched 2026-08-13T18:10:40.706Z.
cases.steps: When the deployed repliedIn/seenOf/interestedOf are run against that contact with win = the campaign-22 launch, and when the deployed refusal reader in src/insights.ts is exercised by check:campaigns across 14 Arabic refusal / non-refusal strings.
cases.expected: Then none of replied, seen or interested may be credited from pre-launch history, and morphologically inflected refusals («لسنا مهتمين», «غير مهتمة») must read as refusals while buying signals («مو مهتم بالسعر بقدر الجودة», «مهتمين جدًا بالتكامل») must not.

The refusal reader measured 12/12 correct in both directions, including «لسنا مهتمين» true and «مو مهتم بالسعر بقدر الجودة» false, and the «الملف التعريفي» false positive stays closed.

cases.title: an unreadable launch time fails CLOSED — shows nothing, never everything
cases.persona: an operator opening a campaign whose launch timestamp is missing or corrupt
cases.preconditions: Given the safety-gate advisory that a bare "0" or "-1" reaching Date.parse resolves to the year 2000 and would open the window on all history through the very fallback meant to close it.
cases.steps: When the deployed campWin is called with created_at set to undefined, null, "", "  ", "0", "-1", 0, -1, "abc", {}, and with the two real shapes "1786644640706" and 1786644640706, and when check:campaigns asserts the resulting campaign counters.
cases.expected: Then every unreadable shape must return Infinity (counters all zero) and only a positive epoch-millis value, string or number, may open a window.
cases.actual: All ten unreadable shapes returned Infinity; none returned 0 and none returned a year-2000-scale number. Both real shapes returned exactly 1786644640706. check:campaigns independently measured [0,0,0,0] counters for all ten, and [0,0,0] for a contact with no status at all.
cases.measured: campWin: undefined→Infinity · null→Infinity · ""→Infinity · "0"→Infinity · "-1"→Infinity · 0→Infinity · -1→Infinity · "abc"→Infinity · "1786644640706"→1786644640706 · 1786644640706→1786644640706. check:campaigns counters measured [0,0,0,0] for every unreadable shape. Reported separately: "2026-08-13T18:10:40.706Z"→Infinity, because the served ISO regex is /^d{4}-d{2}/ (escapes eaten by the TS template literal) — fail-closed, and unreachable with the live int8 schema.

cases.title: campaign and contact data stay behind the admin token
cases.persona: an unauthenticated visitor who has the dashboard URL
cases.preconditions: Given the live deployment at massar-engine.fly.dev with ADMIN_TOKEN set as a Fly secret.
cases.steps: When /admin/state, /admin/campaigns and /admin/customer/966535106365 are fetched with no token and again with a wrong token, and when /dashboard#kmon/22 is rendered in a browser with no token at 1440x900.
cases.expected: Then every admin GET must return 401 and the dashboard must render only the login gate, exposing no campaign number and no customer phone.

No POST was issued to the webhook: its token auth was left untouched per the NO-SEND policy.

cases.persona: the founder whose blast failed at the wire and who must be told so

cases.expected: Then the screen must say the campaign failed rather than inheriting old success: failed 2, delivered 0, a «لم تصلهم الرسالة ٢» recovery card, and no console error on any route.
cases.actual: The campaign header reads «أُرسلت، وبانتظار الرد الأول.» with أُرسلت ٢ · وصلت ٠ · شوهدت ٠ · ردّوا ٠ · جهات مهتمة ٠, the filter chip reads «فشل الإرسال (٢)», and the red recovery card reads «٢ لم تصلهم الرسالة — تحقق من الأرقام، ثم أعد المحاولة لاحقًا». Smoke loaded all seven routes with 0 runtime errors, including #kmon/22 at 7669 chars asserting «حكم الحملة». Console capture on both changed routes reported 0 messages and 0 errors.
cases.measured: smoke: 7/7 routes render, 0 runtime errors, exit 0 (#kmon/22 7669 chars, #customer/966500000850 18856 chars). console: #kmon/22 0 errors, #customer/966535106365 0 errors. On-screen: failed chip ٢, delivered ٠, recovery card present at all three viewports.
